ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) central regions with low-intensity (black) peripheries and streaks. Visible ratio approximately 65% white to 35% black.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central 70% of both lobes. Dense black pixel clusters are mapped along the entire trailing edge and central peduncle region. Distinctive vertical black streaks are localized on the inner-medial section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 70 degrees; the lower vertex is obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from approximately 5 to 15 pixels relative to the edge mean.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on distal edges ending in sharp, upward-tapering lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, circular dark pixel clusters are visible on the lower-third of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-density dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) traversing the white ventral surface, particularly prominent in the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular contouring and potential tissue loss at the distal tip of the right lobe; extensive linear rake marks across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical 'dripping' pigmentation pattern on the medial right lobe extending from the trailing edge toward the fluke center.
